title: OpenBindings Conformance Fixture
description: JSON Schema describing the format of a conformance fixture file (one OBI-D-## or OBI-T-## rule per file). Document fixtures (document/) are keyed by rule. Tool fixtures (tool/) may name the clauses each test exercises (clauses.json). violates names document rules only: a tool rule is never a document violation.

rule.description: The OBI-D-## or OBI-T-## identifier this fixture covers, as defined in §10 of the OpenBindings spec.

section.description: The spec section the rule is defined in (e.g., '10.2' for document rules, '10.3' for tool rules).

description.description: Human-readable description of the rule, ideally byte-faithful to the spec text.

notes.description: Optional file-level rationale text about the rule's coverage in this corpus, e.g. why some test cases are intentionally out of format. Informational; not consumed by harnesses.

coverage.description: If present, marks this fixture as providing partial coverage of its rule. 'positive-only' means the fixture has no discriminating negative cases (typically because negative cases cannot be expressed in the document-level fixture format without per-format harness logic). A fixture marked this way is counted separately in the manifest and does not contribute to a 'complete coverage' claim. Absence means complete coverage.

tests.description: Test cases for this rule. Each case bundles an OBI document with the expected validity verdict.

description.description: Description of what this specific case tests.

document.description: An OBI document embedded as a parsed JSON value. Exactly one of document, documentText, or documentBase64 is present.

documentText.description: Exact Unicode text handed to the document parser. Preserves duplicate keys and malformed JSON that an embedded JSON value cannot carry. Exactly one input carriage is present.

documentBase64.description: Base64 encoding of the exact bytes handed to the document parser. Carries malformed UTF-8 and byte-order marks. Exactly one input carriage is present.

valid.description: true if the document satisfies the rule (a conformant tool should accept it); false if the document violates the rule (a conformant tool should reject it).

violates.description: When valid is false, the minimum set of document rules the document is intended to exercise as violated: a tool that reports violated rules reports at least these. A tool rule is never a document violation. Harness semantics, not a report shape.

notViolated.description: When valid is false, document rules a tool must not report violated, where it reports violated rules at all: the mirror of violates. It records where a rule holds, holds vacuously, or does not govern the document, so a tool that reports it violated misreads the rule. Harness semantics, not a report shape. Disjoint from violates.

requiresMinSupported.description: When set, the test applies only to tools whose declared lowest supported version (the first release of the lowest declared line) is at least this SemVer 2.0.0 version. Used for downward OBI-T-04 refusal tests. Derived from the declaration, never from refusal code; runners skip otherwise, reporting skips separately.

requiresSupports.description: When set, administer this test only to tools whose declared support set includes this SemVer 2.0.0 version: a release whose major.minor line the tool declares, or a prerelease it declares it includes (section 8.1). The harness derives the set from the tool's declaration, never from the tool's acceptance or refusal code, so a defect in that code cannot gate its own tests out. Otherwise runners skip the test, reporting the skip separately (skips are never failures).

clauses.description: Tool-rule clause IDs (corpus-owned, defined in clauses.json) this test exercises. Allowed only in tool/ fixtures, where every test names at least one clause of the file's rule (the verifier checks both).
